title: Zesty Smoky Turkish Potatoes Menemen
description: A yeasty, tender, and romantic Turkish dish featuring potato starch, smoke-hot flavors, and satvik-friendly ingredients, formed into a menemen style dish.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the diced potatoes, smoked paprika, cumin, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender and lightly browned.
Stir in the active dry yeast and cook for another minute.
Serve the menemen hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Serve with crusty bread or pita for a filling breakfast or snack.
